title: KCSAN: data-race in tcp_add_backlog / tcp_try_rmem_schedule
two_threads_summary: KCSAN-reported two-context race. KCSAN: data-race in tcp_add_backlog / tcp_try_rmem_schedule
audit_notes: Subject: 'tcp: annotate sk->sk_rcvbuf lockless reads'. Pre-classifier PROBABLY_GOOD (real synchronization primitives on + lines).
fix_commit_message:
ebb3b78db7bf842270a46fd4fe7cc45c78fa5ed6
tcp: annotate sk->sk_rcvbuf lockless reads

For the sake of tcp_poll(), there are few places where we fetch
sk->sk_rcvbuf while this field can change from IRQ or other cpu.

We need to add READ_ONCE() annotations, and also make sure write
sides use corresponding WRITE_ONCE() to avoid store-tearing.

Note that other transports probably need similar fixes.

Signed-off-by: Eric Dumazet <edumazet@google.com>
Signed-off-by: David S. Miller <davem@davemloft.net>
